answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity through work, not signup. Each vertex task demands verifiable compute and a stake that a bot farm must pay per identity, so spinning up ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand times the work. A dune ledger of attestations lets honest agents vouch for real effort, and reputation decays unless renewed, so rented identities rot. The jade of this design is asymmetry: defending costs one proof, attacking costs a proof per fake, and that gap is what keeps the economy honest.
